title: Context Graph Projection R1
question: What did MNEMOS decide about Context Graph Projection R1?
short_answer: MNEMOS recorded Context Graph Projection R1 as research-only preregistration. The artifacts recommend narrow-scope future consideration only for explicit-reference artifact families and authorize no implementation.

evidence_used.claim_supported: R1 is research-only and does not authorize graph code, graph storage, GraphRAG, retrieval changes, governance changes, promotion changes, context assembly changes, Engram schema changes, or authority changes.
evidence_used.public_safe_summary: Defines the future standard for a JSON-only projection using explicit refs and disclosure checks only.

evidence_used.artifact_title: Context Graph Projection R1 Field Validation Results
evidence_used.claim_supported: Recommendation is NARROW_SCOPE, not GO; field evidence is partial and insufficient for full implementation.
evidence_used.public_safe_summary: Finds promising explicit refs in selected artifact families, but blocks full GO because durable result-set identity, serialized cycle refs, uniform handoff refs, ledger correlation, and graph-specific disclosure rules remain incomplete.

evidence_used.artifact_title: Context Graph Projection R1 Lineage Omission Semantics
evidence_used.claim_supported: Unauthorized or incomplete lineage must not be converted into inferred graph edges.
evidence_used.public_safe_summary: Defines omission and lineage-incomplete boundaries for any future projection.

trace_path.label: decision_record

excluded_or_unsupported_claims.reason: R1 requires explicit refs and rejects inference, semantic guessing, and model judgment.

limitations: This trace summarizes research artifacts only.
It does not prove or demonstrate runtime graph behavior.
It intentionally omits raw receipt content and any private or local log paths.

demo_panels.answer_panel: MNEMOS did not ship Context Graph Projection R1. It preregistered a future research standard and concluded that only a narrow explicit-reference subset may be considered later.
evidence_panel: Lineage semantics: missing or unauthorized relationships must be omitted, not inferred.
decision_boundary_panel: No retrieval or governance behavior change.
trace_panel: Research artifacts -> explicit-ref validation -> NARROW_SCOPE recommendation -> no runtime authorization.
